title: Redundant Connection
keyIdea: A tree plus one extra edge has exactly one cycle. Add edges in order with Union-Find; the first edge whose two ends already share a root closes the cycle, and it is the last cycle edge in the input.

approaches.name: DFS reachability before each edge
approaches.idea: Before adding u-v, DFS from u over the edges so far; if v is reachable, return this edge.
approaches.why: A DFS of up to n nodes for each of n edges.

approaches.name: Union-Find with path compression
approaches.idea: find follows parents to the root (compressing the path); Union merges roots or reports they were already equal.
approaches.why: Each find/union is nearly constant time.

options: When both ends already have the same root: they are already connected
Makes every node on the find path point straight to the root, speeding up later finds

quiz.q: Why is the returned edge the last cycle edge in the input?
options: Edges are added in order; the cycle can only close when its last edge is added

quiz.q: How many edges does a tree with n nodes have?
